subject: Request: short window surge — temporary credit supplement for POC validation
messages:
From: Amit Shah <amit@ledgerai.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement <procurement@ledgerai.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Short notice: need extra credits for weekend throughput window

Hi Logan,

We're ramping a LedgerAI POC that needs a targeted throughput validation this weekend (latency and concurrency stress for our streaming use-case). Our internal timeline slipped and we can only run the heavy load on Saturday morning (UTC). Can Redwood provision a short burst of free credits or a trial extension so we can complete the test and sign off?

Quick context: we've validated correctness on smaller samples but need an end-to-end throughput run at 5M tokens to check autoscaling behavior and KV cache hit rates. The test plan is attached (POC-test-plan.pdf).

Ideal ask: +50k tokens usable from 04/24 06:00 UTC to 04/24 12:00 UTC, or a 72-hour trial extension if credits can't be applied. We know this is short notice — our procurement team is copied for any paperwork.

Appreciate any flexibility — this run will let us move from trial to a committed dedicated capacity conversation quickly.

Thanks,
Amit Shah
Senior ML Engineer | LedgerAI
amit@ledgerai.com
Attachment: POC-test-plan.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit@ledgerai.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short notice: need extra credits for weekend throughput window

Hi Amit — thanks for the clear ask and the test plan.

Short answer: we can usually support short burst supplements for POCs but need a quick internal sign-off and a scoped time window. Two questions before I escalate for approval:
- Can you confirm the expected concurrency profile (rps and sequence length distribution) and whether you require specific GPUs/regions?
- Is LedgerAI comfortable with a scoped usage cap (we'd attach a temporary quota that cuts off automatically at the end time)?

If you confirm those, I'll loop in Finance/Rev Ops for a one-time promotional credit and Priyom for quota configuration. If procurement needs a statement of work or a doc for approvals, I can provide a short blurb.

I copied Rishi so we can weigh in on recommended instance profile and whether to use a quantized variant for cost reasons.

Best,
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
logang.wright@redwood.ai
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 14:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short notice: need extra credits for weekend throughput window

On Tue, Apr 20, 2027 at 11:03 AM Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Amit — thanks for the clear ask and the test plan.
> ...

Logan — quick notes from the runtime side:
- For a 5M token run with realistic streaming behavior, recommend a mix of p3-equivalent reservations for steady-state and a small burst on p4-equivalent for peak concurrency. We can emulate expected KV cache patterns.
- If they care about latency SLOs, suggest running the first 1M tokens with the lower-latency profile to set baseline metrics, then switch to the cost-profile for bulk throughput.

Priyom — could you pre-create a time-limited quota in the us-west-2 region that caps at 60k tokens and auto-expires at 2027-04-24T12:00:00Z? That gives us a safety margin.

Marissa — is a one-time promotional credit of ~USD 300 within policy for a named POC? If yes, please confirm so I can relay to Amit.

Rishi
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Amit Shah <amit@ledgerai.com>, procurement <procurement@ledgerai.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short notice: need extra credits for weekend throughput window

On Tue, Apr 20, 2027 at 2:28 PM Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Priyom — could you pre-create a time-limited quota ...

Team — approved.

Marissa has approved a one-time promotional credit equal to USD 350 and Priyom should create the 60k token time-limited quota in us-west-2 that auto-expires at 2027-04-24T12:00:00Z. Logan, please send Amit a short acceptance note and the temporary quota id once it's created.

Amit/procurement — follow-up items for your team:
- Confirm concurrency profile (rps, sequence distribution) by EOD Thursday 04/22 so Rishi can finalize the run profile.
- If procurement needs a short email confirming the credit amount and that credit is promotional and one-time, we'll provide that.
- Invoice-quote-v2.xlsx attached in case procurement wants an estimated committed baseline price for post-POC conversation.

Thanks — Marissa
Head of Customer Programs | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
